P. (तटति) 
__1 To groan. 
__2 To rise, be raised or elevated. --

[तट्-अच्] 
__1 A slope, declivity, precipice. 
__2 The sky or horizon. 
__3 An epithet of Śiva. 
-टः, -टा, -टी, टम् 
__1 The shore or bank, declivity, slope; शीलं शैलतटात् पततु [[

]]; उच्चारणात् पक्षिगणास्तटीस्तम् [[Śi. 4. 18.]] 
__2 A term applied to certain parts of the body which have, as it were, sloping sides; पद्मापयोधरतटीपरिरम्भलग्न [[

]]; so जघनतट, कटितट, श्रोणीतट, कुचतट, कण्ठतट, ललाटतट &c. 
-टम् A field. 
-Comp. 
-आघातः butting, striking against a bank or declivity; अभ्यस्यन्ति तटाघातं निर्जितैरावता गजाः [[

.]] 
-द्रुमः a tree standing on the shore. 
-भू the shore; आसीना तटभुवि सस्मितेन भर्त्रा [[Śi. 8. 19.]] 
-स्थ a. 
__1 (lit.) situated on a bank or declivity. 
__2 (fig.) standing aloof, neutral, indifferent, alien, passive; तटस्थः स्बानर्थान् घटयति च मौनं च भजते [[

.]] (where तटस्थ has sense 1 also). 
(-स्थः) an indifferent person, one neither a friend nor a foe. 
(-स्थम्) that property or लक्षण of a thing which is distinct from its nature, and yet is the property by which it is known; e. g. गन्धबत्त्व in the case of पृथ्वी.
-कम् A pond (deep enough for the lotus and other aquatic plants); See तडाग.
[तटमस्त्यस्या इनि ङीप्] A river; कदा बाराणस्याममरतटिनीरोधसि वसन् [[
An ornament for the ear, a large ear-ring; तेन मुनिना पारितोषिकं ताटङ्कयुगलमर्पितं तस्य राज्ञः [[P. R.]]

__1 Proximity. 
__2 Indifference, disregard neutrality; see तटस्थ.
